title: Ninth Word Why The Five Daily Prayers Are Assigned To Their Times

questions.question: What main topic is introduced in this passage?
questions.answer: It introduces the wisdom behind why the five daily prayers are tied to specific times.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does each prayer time mark in the world?
questions.answer: Each one marks the beginning of a major change or turning point.

questions.question: Besides marking a change, what else does each prayer time reflect?
questions.answer: It reflects Allah’s power at work and His widespread blessings.

questions.question: Why are glorifying and praising Allah especially fitting at these times?
questions.answer: Because these times gather many blessings and show Allah’s power clearly, so they call for extra praise, thanks, and glorification.

questions.question: What does the passage say is the meaning of the prescribed prayers?
questions.answer: They are acts of glorifying Allah, praising Him, and thanking Him.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the role of countless blessings between one prayer time and the next?
questions.answer: It says those blessings build up between the prayer times and are met with gratitude in prayer.

questions.question: What does the speaker promise to explain about the wisdom of prayer times?
questions.answer: He says he will explain only one example out of many.

questions.question: What does the speaker ask the listener to do in order to understand this meaning better?
questions.answer: He asks the listener to pay close attention along with his own lower self to the five points that will follow.

questions.question: What can we infer about the wisdom of prayer times from the phrase that only one instance will be explained?
questions.answer: We can infer that the wisdom is deep and has many layers, not just one simple reason.

questions.question: Who is being addressed in the passage, and what does that show about the tone?
questions.answer: A brother is being addressed, which gives the passage a personal, caring, and direct tone.

questions.question: What question is being answered in this section?
questions.answer: It is answering why the five daily prayers are set at certain times.

questions.question: How are the times of prayer connected to major events or changes?
questions.answer: Each prayer time is linked to the start of an important shift or transition.

questions.question: What do the prayer times show about Allah’s actions in creation?
questions.answer: They show His management, power, and blessings throughout the universe.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is there more need for thanks at these times?
questions.answer: Because many blessings have been received and gathered by then.

questions.question: What three responses to Allah are emphasized in the passage?
questions.answer: Glorifying Him, praising Him, and thanking Him.

questions.question: How does the passage connect prayer with awareness of blessings?
questions.answer: It presents prayer as the right response to the blessings that continue to come between the appointed times.

questions.question: What does the description of the meaning as “subtle and profound” suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests that the wisdom of prayer times is meaningful, rich, and not obvious to everyone at first.

questions.question: Why does the speaker mention listening together with his own nafs?
questions.answer: It shows humility and suggests that both the listener and the speaker need the reminder.

questions.question: What Qur’anic theme appears at the beginning of the passage before the explanation starts?
questions.answer: It highlights glorifying and praising Allah at different parts of the day.

questions.question: How does that opening theme connect to the subject of prayer times?
questions.answer: It supports the idea that certain times of day are especially appropriate for remembering, praising, and glorifying Allah.

questions.question: What is one reason given for assigning prayers to specified times instead of leaving them completely open?
questions.answer: Specific times match important transitions and make people notice Allah’s power and blessings.

questions.question: What does the passage say each prayer time is a mirror to?
questions.answer: It is a mirror to divine power in action and to universal blessings.

questions.question: What is meant by the blessings being “accumulated” between prayer times?
questions.answer: It means blessings keep coming and piling up until the next prayer becomes a moment to thank Allah for them.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the relationship between prayer and gratitude?
questions.answer: Prayer is a way of expressing gratitude for the many blessings Allah gives.

questions.question: What is the relationship between prayer and glorification in this section?
questions.answer: Prayer is also a way of honoring Allah’s greatness and perfection.

questions.question: Why does the speaker not claim to cover every wisdom in the prayer times here?
questions.answer: Because the subject is broad, and he is only choosing one example from many.

questions.question: What is the central claim about the five prayer times in this passage?
questions.answer: The main claim is that the times are full of wisdom and are not chosen randomly.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the changes connected to prayer times?
questions.answer: It describes them as important shifts or revolutions.

questions.question: What two things are reflected by each prayer time?
questions.answer: Allah’s exercise of power and His blessings spread through creation.

questions.question: Why are believers instructed to increase glorification and praise at those times?
questions.answer: Because those moments make Allah’s power and favors more noticeable.

questions.question: What part do blessings play in understanding the purpose of prayer?
questions.answer: They help show that prayer is a response of thankfulness for what Allah continually gives.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does prescribed prayer mean in practice?
questions.answer: It means regularly turning to Allah with glorification, praise, and thanks.

questions.question: What does the speaker’s phrase about “one of the many” teach about religious understanding?
questions.answer: It teaches that one teaching may have many wise reasons behind it.

questions.question: How does the passage encourage the reader to approach the subject?
questions.answer: It encourages the reader to listen carefully and reflect deeply.

questions.question: What attitude toward learning is modeled by the speaker mentioning his own nafs?
questions.answer: He models humility, self-awareness, and the need for personal reminder.

questions.question: What question from the listener leads into this explanation?
questions.answer: The listener wants to know the wisdom behind the fixed times of the five daily prayers.

questions.question: Does the passage present the prayer times as spiritually meaningful or merely routine? Explain.
questions.answer: It presents them as spiritually meaningful because they are linked to major transitions, divine power, and blessings.

questions.question: What does it mean that each prayer time is a mirror?
questions.answer: It means each time reflects something of Allah’s action and favor in the world.

questions.question: Why would noon, evening, morning, and other set times be suitable for worship according to the passage’s reasoning?
questions.answer: Because they are moments when changes in life and signs of Allah’s care become especially clear.

questions.question: What are believers meant to do when they notice the blessings gathered between prayer times?
questions.answer: They are meant to respond with praise, glorification, and gratitude.

questions.question: How does the passage connect worship to awareness of time?
questions.answer: It teaches that time itself can remind people of Allah and call them to worship.

questions.question: What does the speaker mean by calling the meaning subtle and deep?
questions.answer: He means it takes careful thought to appreciate fully.

questions.question: Why is the reader told to listen to the coming five points?
questions.answer: Because those points will help explain the wisdom more clearly.

questions.question: What is being explained in this selected passage?
questions.answer: It explains one aspect of the wisdom behind the appointed times of the five daily prayers.

questions.question: How many daily prayers are mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: Five daily prayers are mentioned.

questions.question: What does each prayer time begin, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Each one begins a significant turning point.

questions.question: What signs of Allah are especially connected with these times?
questions.answer: Signs of His power and the blessings He gives throughout creation.

questions.question: Why is praise described as more fitting at these moments?
questions.answer: Because these moments highlight how much Allah gives and how powerfully He controls events.

questions.question: What does the passage say has happened between one prayer and the next?
questions.answer: Many blessings have been received and collected.

questions.question: What three forms of devotion are named as the meaning of the prayers?
questions.answer: Glorification, extolling Allah’s greatness, and giving thanks.

questions.question: What can be inferred from the speaker’s decision to explain only one wisdom?
questions.answer: It can be inferred that the prayer times have many benefits and meanings beyond what is discussed here.

questions.question: How does the ending of the passage prepare the reader for what comes next?
questions.answer: It tells the reader that the explanation will continue through five points, so this section serves as an introduction.
